content: At present, most multilayer community detection heuristics require the community structure to be homogenous at each layer, but as displayed above, speech and voting patterns often diverge. A recently proposed solution to this problem is the Multilayer Extraction procedure BIBREF27 . The algorithm identifies densely connected vertex-layers in multilayer networks through a significance-based score that quantifies the connectivity of an observed vertex-layer set by comparison with a multilayer fixed degree random graph model. For our analysis, the clusters from voting data comprise the first layer and the text-based clusters comprise the second layer of the graph for each year.
